assumptions.text: The root for referrer scan is the current directory (lint(..., root=Path('.')) via git ls-files); main() passes nothing, so the lint must run from the repo root.
A referrer counts as named when its path appears as a substring anywhere in the spec text; the removed file itself is excluded.
A report written before `runs` existed is treated as one earlier run built from its top-level started/tokens/escalations. A missing or unreadable report is treated as no earlier runs.
Top-level tokens/escalations in the report still describe only the current run, so accept's escalation gate is unchanged. Accept (a later task) sums `runs` for the total.
A build-report.json from before `runs` existed is treated as one run (`report` itself), so it shows '(1 build run)'.
The answer-commit count searches all history reachable from HEAD, not only main..HEAD. The slice name in the subject keeps it specific.
test_e12_031_records_true_numbers fails because specs/031-clear-sdlc/spec.md lacks the '5 interventions' / '1,010,245 tokens' reported lines. No task in my scope covers it, so I left it.
Put both figures in a single table row in section 7 rather than two rows; the test accepts either.
